citation.authors: Callender V, Burgess C, Harvey VM, Heath C et al

record.design: Systematic review of hair-type classifications without reference to race or ethnicity
record.finding: Four mainstream classification systems exist (Andre Walker, LOIS, FIA, L'Oreal). The authors state hair type classification is under-used in clinical practice and argue it should be based on shape criteria rather than race.

cited_by.title: Hair types 4a, 4b, 4c: what typing tells you

record.finding: Curl classification may have predictive value for scalp disease such as seborrhoeic dermatitis, but further validation is required.
record.note: Unrestricted grant from CeraVe (L'Oreal group); authors paid consultants (baseline file).
